column7: DeprovisionSCIMUser (the IdP offboarding path) swept SESSIONS only -- it never called RevokeAllPersonalAccessTokensForUser, unlike every other deprovisioning path (setAccountState's blocked-state branch, DeleteUser, RevokeUserCredentialsForDeactivation), all of which revoke both. A surviving PAT is inert while the account is deprovisioned (ValidatePATToken re-checks is_active and the account state), but ReactivateUser and RestoreUser deliberately revoke nothing on the assumption the deprovision already did -- so an IdP offboard followed by a restore handed every PAT back, possibly with no expiry, after an audit trail recording a completed deprovision. Fixed by revoking in the SAME transaction (keeping SCIM DELETE all-or-nothing) and folding the hashes into the existing post-commit auth-cache eviction. Red on PRISTINE origin/main with only the test added: the PAT AUTHENTICATED after a restore. Found by RACE-FIX-2 while fixing #2701, which flagged it as "related, not a race"
